operations.name: GetServiceCapabilities
operations.description: This operation returns the capabilities of the credential service.

fields.name: Capabilities

definition.name: ServiceCapabilities
definition.description:
The service capabilities reflect optional functionality of a service. The information is static
						and does not change during device operation. The following capabilities are available:

fields.name: SupportedIdentifierType

definition.name: Name
definition.description: Type used for names of logical and physical entities.

fields.description:
A list of identifier types that the device supports. Is of type text.
								Identifier types starting with the prefix pt: are reserved to define ONVIF-specific
								types as defined in pt:RecognitionType. Please note that pt:REX is not an identifier
								type. For custom defined identifier types, free text can be used.

fields.name: SupportedExemptionType

definition.name: Name
definition.description: Type used for names of logical and physical entities.

fields.description:
A list of exemptions that the device supports. Supported exemptions starting with the
	                prefix pt: are reserved to define ONVIF specific exemption types and these reserved
	                exemption types shall all share "pt:<Name>" syntax.

attributes.name: MaxLimit

definition.name: PositiveInteger
definition.description: Type used to represent the numbers from 1 ,2 , 3,...

attributes.description:
The maximum number of entries returned by a single Get<Entity>List or Get<Entity>
							request. The device shall never return more than this number of entities in a single response.

attributes.name: CredentialValiditySupported
attributes.description: Indicates that the device supports credential validity.

attributes.name: CredentialAccessProfileValiditySupported
attributes.description:
Indicates that the device supports validity on the association between a credential and an
							access profile.

attributes.name: ValiditySupportsTimeValue
attributes.description:
Indicates that the device supports both date and time value for validity. If set to false,
							then the time value is ignored.

attributes.name: MaxCredentials
attributes.description:
The maximum number of credential supported by the device.
							If set to 0, then operations using credential token are not supported.

attributes.name: MaxAccessProfilesPerCredential

definition.name: PositiveInteger
definition.description: Type used to represent the numbers from 1 ,2 , 3,...

attributes.description: The maximum number of access profiles for a credential.

attributes.name: ResetAntipassbackSupported
attributes.description:
Indicates the device supports resetting of anti-passback violations and notifying on
							anti-passback violations.

attributes.name: ClientSuppliedTokenSupported
attributes.description:
Indicates that the client is allowed to supply the token when creating credentials. 
							To enable the use of the command SetCredential, the value must be set to true.

attributes.name: DefaultCredentialSuspensionDuration
attributes.description:
The default time period that the credential will temporary be suspended (e.g. by using
							the wrong PIN a predetermined number of times).
							The time period is defined as an [ISO 8601] duration string (e.g. "PT5M").

attributes.name: MaxWhitelistedItems
attributes.description: The maximum number of whitelisted credential identifiers supported by the device.

attributes.name: MaxBlacklistedItems
attributes.description: The maximum number of blacklisted credential identifiers supported by the device.

fields.description:
The capability response message contains the requested credential
									service capabilities using a hierarchical XML capability structure.

operations.name: GetSupportedFormatTypes
operations.description: This method returns all the supported format types of a specified identifier type that is supported by the device.

fields.name: CredentialIdentifierTypeName
fields.description: Name of the credential identifier type

fields.name: FormatTypeInfo

definition.name: CredentialIdentifierFormatTypeInfo
definition.description: Contains information about a format type.

fields.name: FormatType
fields.description:
A format type supported by the device. A list of supported format types is
								provided in [ISO 16484-5:2014-09 Annex P]. The BACnet type "CUSTOM" is not used in this
								specification. Instead device manufacturers can define their own format types.

fields.name: Description

definition.name: Description
definition.description:
Description is optional and the maximum length is device specific.
				If the length is more than maximum length, it is silently chopped to the maximum length
				supported by the device/service (which may be 0).

fields.description:
User readable description of the credential identifier format type. It
								shall be up to 1024 characters. For custom types, it is recommended to describe how the
								octet string is encoded (following the structure in column Authentication Factor Value
								Encoding of [ISO 16484-5:2014-09 Annex P]).
Identifier format type

operations.name: GetCredentialInfo
operations.description: This operation requests a list of CredentialInfo items matching the given tokens. The device shall ignore tokens it cannot resolve and shall return an empty list if there are no items matching the specified tokens. The device shall not return a fault in this case. If the number of requested items is greater than MaxLimit, a TooManyItems fault shall be returned.

fields.name: Token

definition.name: ReferenceToken
definition.description:
Type used to reference logical and physical entities.
			Token may be extended by intermediate terminal with adding prefix to make it global unique.
			The length should be within 36 characters for generating as a local token.
			See "Remote Token" section in Resource Query specification.

fields.description: Tokens of CredentialInfo items to get.

fields.name: CredentialInfo

definition.name: CredentialInfo
definition.description:

						the basic information of a specific credential instance. The device shall provide the following
						fields for each credential.

base_definition.description:
General data structure referenced by a token.
				Should be used as extension base.

definition.description:

attributes.description: A service-unique identifier of the item.

definition.name: Description
definition.description:
Description is optional and the maximum length is device specific.
				If the length is more than maximum length, it is silently chopped to the maximum length
				supported by the device/service (which may be 0).

fields.description: User readable description for the credential. It shall be up to 1024 characters.

fields.name: CredentialHolderReference
fields.description:
An external reference to a person holding this credential. The
										reference is a username or used ID in an external system, such as a directory
										service.

fields.name: ValidFrom
fields.description:
The start date/time validity of the credential. If the
										ValiditySupportsTimeValue capability is set to false, then only date is
										supported (time is ignored).

fields.name: ValidTo
fields.description:
The expiration date/time validity of the credential. If the
										ValiditySupportsTimeValue capability is set to false, then only date is
										supported (time is ignored).
List of CredentialInfo items.

operations.name: GetCredentialInfoList
operations.description: This operation requests a list of all CredentialInfo items provided by the device. A call to this method shall return a StartReference when not all data is returned and more data is available. The reference shall be valid for retrieving the next set of data. Please refer to section 4.8.3 in [ONVIF Access Control Service Specification] for more details. The number of items returned shall not be greater than the Limit parameter.

fields.name: Limit
fields.description:
Maximum number of entries to return. If not specified, less than one
									or higher than what the device supports, the number of items is determined by the
									device.

fields.name: StartReference
fields.description:
Start returning entries from this start reference. If not specified,
									entries shall start from the beginning of the dataset.

fields.name: NextStartReference
fields.description:
StartReference to use in next call to get the following items. If
									absent, no more items to get.

              for the PIN.

operations.name: CreateCredential
operations.description: This operation creates a credential. A call to this method takes a credential structure and a credential state structure as input parameters. The credential state can be created in disabled or enabled state. The token field of the credential shall be empty, the device shall allocate a token for the credential. The allocated token shall be returned in the response. If the client sends any value in the token field, the device shall return InvalidArgVal as generic fault code.

Maximum number of entries to return. If not specified, less than one or higher than what the device
                  supports, the number of items is determined by the device.

fields.name: StartReference
fields.description:
Start returning entries from this start reference. If not specified, entries shall start from the
                  beginning of the dataset.

fields.name: IdentifierType
fields.description: Get only blacklisted credential identifiers with the specified identifier type.

fields.name: FormatType
fields.description: Get only blacklisted credential identifiers with the specified identifier format type.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Get only blacklisted credential identifiers with the specified identifier value.

fields.name: NextStartReference
fields.description: StartReference to use in next call to get the following items. If absent, no more items to get.

fields.name: Identifier

definition.name: CredentialIdentifierItem
definition.description:
A credential identifier is a card number, unique card information, PIN or biometric information
            such as fingerprint, iris, vein, face recognition, that can be validated in an access point.

fields.name: Type

definition.name: CredentialIdentifierType
definition.description:
Specifies the name of credential identifier type and its format for the credential
						value.

fields.name: Name

definition.name: Name
definition.description: Type used for names of logical and physical entities.

fields.description:
The name of the credential identifier type, such as pt:Card, pt:PIN,
								etc.

fields.name: FormatType
fields.description:
Specifies the format of the credential value for the specified identifier
								type name.
Contains the details of the credential identifier type.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The value of the identifier in hexadecimal representation.
The blacklisted credential identifiers matching the request criteria.

operations.name: AddToBlacklist
operations.description: This command adds the specified credential identifiers to the blacklist. A device with capability MaxBlacklistedItems greater than zero, shall implement this command. If a specified blacklist item also is whitelisted, the item shall be removed from the whitelist.

operations.name: RemoveFromBlacklist
operations.description: This command removes the specified credential identifiers from the blacklist. A device with capability MaxBlacklistedItems greater than zero, shall implement this command. This command is idempotent and is safe to repeat even if the specified blacklist items do not exist.

operations.name: DeleteBlacklist
operations.description: This command deletes all credential identifiers from the blacklist. A device with capability MaxBlacklistedItems greater than zero, shall implement this command. This command is idempotent and is safe to repeat even if the blacklist already is empty.
